1.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid end to end along the strip, standing still.

2.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid along the strip breathes in and out as one.

3.palette_note: With a palette: the whole strip cycles through the palette; Saturation still whitens it.

4.palette_note: With a palette: the palette moves along the strip at the rainbow's pace.

5.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs along the strip and scrolls slowly.

6.palette_note: With a palette: the palette sweeps back and forth along the strip in waves of brightness.

7.palette_note: With a palette: the bright waves run through the palette instead of the rainbow.

8.palette_note: With a palette: the swinging dot slowly cycles through the palette (about 11 s a round).

9.palette_note: With a palette: each twinkle takes a palette colour, a new one each time it lights.

10.palette_note: With a palette: each twinkle takes a random palette colour.

11.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid along the strip flickers as one flame.

12.palette_note: With a palette: every pixel flickers on its own, in its colour of the palette laid along the strip.

13.palette_note: With a palette: which of the two drifting curtains leads picks the palette colour.

14.palette_note: With a palette: the palette ripples back and forth along the strip and drifts through.

15.palette_note: With a palette: each zone shows the whole palette, neighbours flowing in opposite ways.

16.palette_note: With a palette: the heat runs through the palette, coolest to hottest.

17.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs across the strip instead of colours 1-2-3, repeating and scrolling as set.

18.palette_note: With a palette: the waves take the palette's colours, dark troughs to bright crests; the whitecaps stay white.

19.palette_note: With a palette: each pixel moves from the palette's start to its end as the sun rises.

20.palette_note: With a palette: each pixel moves from the palette's end back to its start as it sets.

21.palette_note: With a palette: the palette drifts slowly along the strip, twice over; the sparkles stay Sparkle.

22.palette_note: With a palette: the head takes the palette's last colour and the tail runs back through it to the first.

23.palette_note: With a palette: each slow twinkle takes a random palette colour.

24.palette_note: With a palette: three moving waves add up to pick the palette colour along the strip.

25.palette_note: With a palette: slowly drifting noise picks the palette colour along the strip.

26.palette_note: With a palette: the waves carry the palette along the strip; the troughs go dark.

27.palette_note: With a palette: each ring takes a random palette colour.

28.palette_note: With a palette: with Colours 128 and up, each wipe brings a new palette colour.

29.palette_note: With a palette: the stripes take the palette's 16 colours in turn, hard-edged as ever.

30.palette_note: With a palette: the bulbs step through the palette by Colour step; the colours hop along.

31.palette_note: With a palette: the three blobs take colours a third apart, turning about once a minute.

32.palette_note: With a palette: each tile melts from one random palette colour to another.

33.palette_note: With a palette: each ribbon carries the palette along its length, the two half a palette apart.

34.palette_note: With a palette: the wash is the palette laid along the strip; the leaf shadows darken it.

35.palette_note: With a palette: each facet takes a random palette colour.

36.palette_note: With a palette: the pearls take the palette's colours at its start, a third and two thirds.
